name: U.S. Virgin Islands
summary_text: U.S. Virgin Islands: full US federal law applies; conservative Baptist island culture; archaic code provisions survive the 2014 revision — old delta predates the federal escalation. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United States (0.36) plus a local delta of -0.02. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.
